changes.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle reduces downtime for automatic minor version upgrades and scheduled maintenance
changes.detail: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now reduces downtime for automatic minor version upgrades, as well as minor version upgrades and operating system updates scheduled for your maintenance window. Shorter maintenance makes it easier to stay current on the latest Oracle minor versions and operating system updates with less disruption to your applications. If you turned on automatic minor version upgrade, your DB instances benefit automatically. To apply these upgrades and updates, RDS has to set up new resources as part of the maintenance.
